# Subway Seat for Zellij

Themes in Zellij's component spec (0.42+): an orange frame on the focused pane, gold in other modes, orange ribbons for the active tab. A legacy colour-list version is included for older releases; `theme_dark` and `theme_light` can pair Walnut with Enamel.

[Zellij](https://zellij.dev) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zellij/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/zellij/config.kdl:

```kdl
theme "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/zellij/config.kdl:

```kdl
theme "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/zellij/config.kdl:

```kdl
theme "subway-seat-enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
